summary: End-to-end frontend testing of LAVANET POS/ERP (LocalStorage-only). Executed all 22 requested scenarios via Playwright against the public URL. All 12 nav routes, POS checkout (customer creation, service selection, qty, payment, checkout modal + generated order number), Órdenes timeline transitions (Recibida → En lavado → Lista para entregar), Órdenes status filter, Entregas confirmation, Clientes/Servicios/Productos/Inventario/Usuarios/Configuración/Caja/Reportes CRUD and flows, notifications popover, LocalStorage persistence after reload, logout, and mobile 375x800 sidebar open/close all worked as specified. Invalid-credentials login stayed on /login. Low-stock badges rendered correctly.

issues: Order number and customer name appear concatenated with no visible separator/whitespace in the confirmation text (e.g. 'ORD-1027ClienteQA'). Add a space or line-break between the order ID and the following text for readability.

action_items: Cosmetic: add whitespace between the newly-created order number and customer/label text in the POS checkout confirmation modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Productos: `edit-producto-save` silently rejects when SKU is empty (only a toast). Consider marking SKU field with HTML5 required or focusing the empty field so users get inline feedback in addition to the toast.

Configuración: `cfg-tax-rate` lives under the 'Impuestos' tab while `cfg-name` is under 'Negocio'. Tests/consumers must switch tabs first — acceptable, but consider documenting or adding stable tab data-testids (already present as tab-tax) in the review docs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (22/22 scenarios passed; cfg-tax-rate skipped in one run because tab-tax needed to be activated first — not a defect)

seed_data_creation: Created via UI: customer 'QA Cliente' + 'QA Cliente 2', service 'Servicio QA', product 'Producto QA' (SKU QA-001-xxx), inventory 'entrada' +5, cash session (S/200 opening, S/50 ingreso, closed), user 'qauserNNN', order ORD-1027 (checked out, advanced through timeline to Entregada). All persisted to LocalStorage keys lavanet_data_v1 / lavanet_auth_v1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 modules and end-to-end flow verified against public URL https://lavanet-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. Only cosmetic issue found in POS confirmation modal. window.confirm dialogs (delete, close cash) handled via page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()). Note: when testing Configuración, click [data-testid=tab-tax] before interacting with cfg-tax-rate.
